contract_reproduction.basis: The traceability register maps R-01 through R-16 to exact PLAN clauses, the sole §20 roadmap, validation, and human gates. PLAN §§2, 9, 10.1, 14, 15, and 17 reproduce install, ideation/research, typed decisions, exact-digest READY, admission, isolated execution, review, merge/effect reconciliation, observation, rollback, cleanup, consumer release, export, and uninstall. The Issue/CLI surface is explicitly a future unimplemented contract with session-derived identity, durable typed outcomes, replay, status/why, waits, and fail-closed errors.

Protected Git, authenticated human issuance, approval custody, the purpose-only PolicyAdmissionReceipt issuer, runtime validation, narrow actuators, durable facts, external resources, and disposable workers have separated authority. Only closed R0/R1 items may use bounded delegation after every human-needed predicate is false; R2-R4 and exception, UNKNOWN, canary, widening, promotion, cleanup-risk, quiescence, and break-glass decisions remain human controlled. Typed tenant+ScopeRef identity, signed context, purpose-bound approvals, restricted database roles, total sandbox selection, capability intersection, supply-chain pins, and non-waivable break-glass boundaries fail closed.

PLAN §20 is the sole increment-numbering authority. Release 0 is one-owner/one-repository, read-only, credential-free, restartable, repair-receipted, and exportable. Any external writer waits for the Increment 3 PostgreSQL restricted-role, CAS/outbox, database-time lease, restore/replay, and real two-session race gate. A second repository also waits for FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY or stronger isolation, substitution tests, and Increment 8. Reviews bind exact heads and expire on change; auto-merge remains off through Release 0 and the draft-PR pilot, then is limited to one earned closed R1 profile.

Consumer releases inventory, pin, and rehash every managed input/output and emit verification or rollback receipts through self-test, isolated dogfood, and opt-in rings. Cross-boundary transfer requires a dual-owner, purpose/field-limited, expiring, revocable envelope and receipt. Engineering remains first. GTM begins only after engineering admission as proposal/read-only research with a named owner; publication, spend, and contact remain human-gated.

findings.title: The current traceability document still says round-7 regeneration is pending and stale while also saying it is complete
findings.requirement: The plan-only closure package must state checkout-level evidence and review readiness consistently, so a reader can distinguish completed schema-3 regeneration from the still-pending fresh immutable retrieval, semantic review, implementation, model, and independent-closure gates.
evidence: review/requirements-traceability.md §6 says: 'The current round-7 formal edit makes regeneration pending again.'
review/requirements-traceability.md §7 says: 'The current round-7 formal edit now makes its byte digests and heading set stale pending later regeneration.'

review/requirements-traceability.md §8 says the schema-3 graph 'now matches the current PLAN/manifest digests and all 27 headings,' although the current manifest and graph contain 28 numbered headings.

The same file §9 says round-7 regeneration now matches current PLAN/manifest bytes and 28 headings, and §10 repeats that it matches all 28 dynamically derived headings. README.md Status and review/round-7-resolution.md likewise state that regeneration is complete.

Independent recomputation confirms the current digests are PLAN 25f6960b677d7d4a62c7a55c6bcbbe6ebe744e176c41855cbf08ffa5ed2f6acc and manifest b1cd4933042162367d7e6a3d8e42f07f85ad3308ffd5d38b5882500a3f542413, both equal material-claims.json generated_against, and the derived/reviewed heading sets are exactly equal at 28.
findings.impact: The named current requirements/status artifact gives mutually exclusive readiness states and the wrong current heading count. A reader cannot reliably tell whether checkout-level regeneration is complete or still blocks review, and may confuse that completed local step with the genuinely pending future immutable evidence and semantic gates. It also means the round-7 resolution claim that this status contradiction was corrected is not true of the current bytes.
findings.recommendation: Rewrite traceability §§6-8 as explicitly historical statements. Remove the present-tense round-7 pending/stale clauses, and replace the 27-heading current claim with wording that the earlier round-6 graph covered its then-current 27 headings while the round-7 schema-3 graph matches the current digests and dynamically derived 28-heading set. Preserve fresh immutable retrieval, human semantic review, implementation/model gates, and independent closure as distinct future work.
findings.verification: README.md, PLAN §§4 and 24, requirements-traceability.md §§6-10, round-7-resolution.md, and material-claims.json must all distinguish completed current-byte candidate-only regeneration from pending future evidence/implementation gates, with no present-tense stale/pending contradiction and no fixed or incorrect current heading count.

residual_uncertainty: No implementation, full reachable-product/model proof, operational safety proof, external source truth/currentness, or human semantic entailment review was required or inferred.

Fresh immutable retrieval in one ResearchRun, same-run human semantic review, reviewed-edge regeneration, Increment 0/1 gates, and later persistence/admission gates remain future work rather than findings.
